forecast.activation_rule: personal chronological validation MAE must be no worse than 1.02 times the best ARIMA or weighted-baseline MAE
forecast.calendar_feature: live Nepal holiday ICS plus individual historical festival uplift

limitations: Base artifacts use synthetic bootstrap data and are not an accuracy claim.
The LSTM is activated only after per-user fine-tuning and chronological backtesting.
Institution-specific OCR and category accuracy must be measured on consented labelled holdout data.
